description: The greatest of the burial mounds on the Highmoor Steppes — a stone-lined warren beneath the grass crown, raised over the bones of the first Wardens. Until recently it was quiet. Something inside has stopped sleeping.

rooms.name: Offering Chamber
rooms.description: A narrow side chamber, its far wall recessed into a shallow alcove holding a flat altar of polished black stone. The altar bears a single carved depression in its center, perfectly the size of a Watcher's honor-stone. The eastern wall behind the altar shows the joints of a hidden door, sealed for now.

rooms.description: A small antechamber facing a great pair of stone doors carved with the four Watcher sigils — dawn, dusk, storm, star — and at the doors' joining a fifth sigil: the sealed eye. rooms.name: Watcher's Approach
rooms.description: A wide stone-vaulted approach lined with carved relief friezes of the four Watchers in their long vigil. The floor is dark with old wax-spill from a hundred years of vigil-candles. Faint runic shapes glow softly red in the wall-arches, and the air smells of metal warming. To the east a side passage breaks off; the way north lies straight ahead, into the heart of the barrow.

At the far end stands an iron-banded coffer, and the dust-thick floor around it has been recently disturbed.

rooms.name: Heart of the Barrow
rooms.description: The deepest chamber of the mound, a wide circular vault with a stone bier at its center. The chamber's vaulted roof is hung with cairn-stones tied with ancient rope, set to fall the moment intruders cross the inner threshold.

npcs.name: Barrow-Wight Esketh
npcs.description: A tall figure in tattered grave-linen, crowned with a diadem of fused finger-bones. Esketh's flesh is grey and gone-translucent, but the eyes still burn — a steady, watchful light, neither malevolent nor kind. He does not speak. The barrow speaks for him, in the slow grinding of its stone.

phases.name: Barrow's Embrace
phases.transitionMessage: Esketh slams one hand against the barrow wall and the stone answers — grey light floods up through the floor, wreathing his form in layers of grave-dust and warding fog. His movements slow but each step carries the weight of the hill itself.

phases.name: Unbound Revenant
phases.transitionMessage: The diadem of finger-bones cracks and falls away. Esketh's form shudders — the careful restraint of millennia shattering in an instant. His eyes blaze white-hot and his limbs elongate, grave-linen tearing as something older and angrier tears its way out from within.

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.message: Esketh exhales a wave of barrow-cold that seeps into your very bones!

abilities.name: Barrow Collapse
abilities.message: Esketh slams the floor and the barrow ceiling cracks — stones rain down on all who stand within!
